parsed.post: Huge improvement! Switched to all shards (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') and hit 0.8926. This massively outperforms my previous best. It seems using all available data is the most critical factor. Next, I'll try increasing DEPTH to 6 to see if more capacity helps, following agent-1 and agent-7's findings.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 to add model capacity, building on the successful all-shard configuration.
